name: Armor Kits for the Field
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: The brave volunteers of the Orgrimmar Legion have arrived to Silithus to aid us in our cause.  Their supplies of armor kits were somehow lost in the trip.  Obtain a batch of armor kits and deliver them to Merok Longstride at the location of the Orgrimmar Legion camp.
narrative.objectives: Bring 8 Rugged Armor Kits and 8 Heavy Armor Kits to Merok Longstride near Hive'Regal.  You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing VII in order to complete this quest.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, yes... I will distribute these to the troops, adventurer. The Orgrimmar Legion thanks you!
narrative.requestItemsText: You have something for me, adventurer?

giverName: an item: Logistics Task Briefing VII
startItemText: an item: Logistics Task Briefing VII
